situation: Paris, 1925. You are the real con man Victor Lustig, and you are about to sell the Eiffel Tower for scrap.

scenario.title: Sold: One Eiffel Tower
scenario.setting: A private salon at the Hôtel de Crillon, Paris, spring 1925. Velvet chairs, cigar smoke, official papers fanned across the table, the door shut.
scenario.user_role: Victor Lustig, posing as Deputy Director of the Ministry of Posts and Telegraphs
scenario.user_goal: Get Poisson to hand over the money today.
user_knows: The tower really is costly to maintain, as the papers keep saying
The bids are a state secret, or so you have told him

cast.name: André Poisson
cast.appearance: Thick-set man about 50, new expensive suit that doesn't sit right, thick moustache, nervous hands
cast.voice: Blunt, likes numbers, tries to sound important
cast.history: You flattered him over lunch yesterday.
cast.goal: Land the deal of his life
cast.secret: He is new money and the big dealers laugh at him; he would overpay to be taken seriously
cast.reveal_when: You treat him as the one serious man in the trade
red_lines: Won't pay anything until his doubts are settled

cast.name: Dan Collins
cast.appearance: Dapper man about 40, thin moustache, pinstripe suit, leather folder under his arm
cast.voice: Smooth, low voice, speaks in hints
cast.history: You have run a dozen jobs together.
cast.goal: Get out of here with the cash before anyone calls the ministry
cast.secret: He knows the surest proof you are a real official: ask for a bribe, because only real officials do
cast.reveal_when: You ask him quietly how to win back their trust
red_lines: Never breaks cover in front of the Poissons

cast.name: Madame Poisson
cast.appearance: Sharp-eyed woman about 48, dark cloche hat, fur collar, handbag clasped in her lap
cast.voice: Dry, unimpressed, asks the one awkward question
cast.history: You have not met; she insisted on coming.
cast.goal: Stop her husband from making a fool of himself
cast.secret: Her cousin clerks at a ministry and she can telephone him tomorrow morning
cast.reveal_when: You ask why she is so sure or try to rush her
red_lines: Will not be charmed by flattery alone

scenario.opening_line: Seven thousand tons, you said. So tell me, Monsieur, why's a man like me hearing this in a hotel?

events.description: The door opens. Poisson's wife walks in uninvited, sits down and puts her bag on your papers.
events.shot: A sharp-eyed woman in a cloche hat sits at the table beside the man, her handbag on the papers.

events.description: She looks at your frayed cuff and asks why a man so high in the ministry wears a shirt like that.
events.shot: The woman leans in, staring at you with raised eyebrows; her husband looks suddenly unsure.

events.description: Poisson slowly takes a thick envelope from his jacket, puts it on the table, and keeps his hand on it.
events.shot: A thick envelope on the table under the man's hand; the woman beside him watches you.

success_criteria: Answers the wife's doubts without losing composure
Gets Poisson to let go of the money

assets.basis: Based on a true story. The dialogue is imagined.
